entries.name: Text
entries.description: A paragraph of plain text.

a11y.name: none
a11y.notes: Rendered as a paragraph; text is never parsed as HTML.

props.text: Orders keep their own copy of the product.

entries.name: Heading
entries.description: A section heading at level 2, 3 or 4, so the document fits the host's outline.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Documents start below the host's page heading (level 1).

entries.name: Image
entries.description: An image from a relative or https URL on an admitted origin, with required alternative text.

a11y.notes: Decorative images get an empty alt and are hidden from assistive technology.

entries.name: Stack
entries.description: Arranges children in a row or column on the spacing scale.

a11y.name: none
a11y.notes: No role; reading order follows document order.

entries.name: Card
entries.description: A titled surface that groups related content, with optional header actions.

actions.description: Header actions such as a badge or a button.

a11y.notes: A section with a heading at the level the document sets.

props.text: Orders keep their own copy of the product.

entries.name: Button
entries.description: Triggers an admitted host action. Without an admitted action it renders disabled.

press.description: The button was activated by pointer, Enter or Space.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Busy sets aria-busy, disables the button and shows a decorative spinner.

entries.name: IconButton
entries.description: A button with only an icon and a required accessible label.
entries.codeOnly: Icons are code; documents use Button with a visible label.

a11y.notes: The label is the accessible name and the tooltip.

entries.name: LinkButton
entries.description: Navigation that looks like a button; keeps link semantics. URLs must be relative or on an admitted https origin.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Absolute links open in a new tab without referrer or opener.

entries.name: Badge
entries.description: A short status label.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Tone is visual only; the text carries the meaning.

entries.name: Spinner
entries.description: Progress of unknown length. With a label it is a polite status; without one it is decorative.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: The label is read as hidden status text; motion stops under prefers-reduced-motion.

entries.name: VisuallyHidden
entries.description: Text only for assistive technology.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Hidden visually, read by screen readers.

entries.name: Field
entries.description: Binds a label, hint and error to one control.
entries.codeOnly: Documents use the labelled controls TextInput, TextArea, Select, Checkbox and Switch, which render their Field.

a11y.notes: The control gets the label by id and the hint or error through aria-describedby.

entries.name: TextInput
entries.description: A labelled single-line text field. The value stays in the view until committed.

change.description: The value was committed (blur or Enter).

a11y.notes: Errors set aria-invalid and are announced through aria-describedby.

entries.name: TextArea
entries.description: A labelled multi-line text field.

a11y.notes: Multi-line; Enter inserts a line break.

entries.name: Select
entries.description: A labelled choice from a short list.

a11y.notes: A native select.

entries.name: Checkbox
entries.description: A labelled checkbox.

change.description: The box was ticked or cleared.

a11y.notes: A native checkbox linked to its label.

entries.name: Switch
entries.description: An on/off switch for a setting that applies at once.

change.description: The switch was turned on or off.

a11y.notes: aria-checked follows the state.

entries.name: Notice
entries.description: A message about the current state. Danger is announced at once; other tones are polite.

action.description: One follow-up action, such as retry.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Danger uses role=alert, every other tone role=status.

props.title: Failed
props.text: The payment provider did not answer.

entries.name: EmptyState
entries.description: Explains why a list or area is empty and what to do next.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: A section whose title is a level-3 heading.

props.title: No orders yet
props.text: Orders appear here as soon as customers buy.

entries.name: Tabs
entries.description: Switches between panels of related content.

a11y.notes: Roving focus with automatic activation; panels are linked to their tabs.

entries.name: TabPanel
entries.description: One tab and its panel inside Tabs.

a11y.notes: Labelled by its tab; only the selected panel is rendered.

entries.name: Menu
entries.description: A button that opens a list of actions.

a11y.notes: Escape and outside presses close the menu and return focus to the trigger.

entries.name: Dialog
entries.description: A modal dialog with focus containment and restoration.
entries.codeOnly: A document may not open a modal over its host; hosts open Dialog from their own controls.

close.description: Escape, the backdrop or a footer action closed the dialog.

a11y.notes: aria-modal; focus returns to the opener.

entries.name: ProductCard
entries.description: A product tile with image, name, price, tax note and stock from the shop.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: The name links to the product page; prices come only from the host.

entries.name: ProductSummary
entries.description: The purchase area of a product: variants, price, stock and add to cart.

addToCart.description: The buyer asked to add the product.

select.description: The buyer chose a variant option.

open.description: The buyer opened reviews or variants.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Add to cart is a host action; the document never confirms a purchase.

entries.name: CartSummary
entries.description: Priced cart lines, discounts, taxes and totals as the server calculated them.

quantity.description: The buyer changed a line quantity; the server reprices.

checkout.description: The buyer asked to continue to checkout.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Totals are announced as text; quantity fields are labelled per line.

entries.name: CheckoutSteps
entries.description: Where the buyer is in checkout; it never implies a confirmed payment.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: The current step carries aria-current=step.

entries.name: AccountOverview
entries.description: The account home: greeting, counts and recent orders of the signed-in customer.

open.description: The customer opened an order or account page.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Personal data; only the storefront account host admits it.

entries.name: OrderList
entries.description: The signed-in customer's orders.

a11y.name: content
a11y.notes: Personal data; only the storefront account host admits it.
